title: 240813_153135_FR_Tourists_in_Riquewihr by kevp888
author: kevp888
sourceDescription: Tourists in Riquewihr, France. I made this recording during a nice summer day, in the famous traditional village named Riquewihr, located in the east of France. One can hear tourists chatting and rambling, with the sound of a fountain in the background. At about #1:50, a car will pass by slowly in the cobbled pedestrian area. Then, at about #2:50, someone carrying bottles in a big backpack will pass by, probably to deliver them to a coffee shop located on the top of the village. Slightly after #5:10, a cyclist will pass slowly. Recorded in August 2024 with a Zoom H6essential (built-in XY micro
